Description

The Kiierr 272 Premier uses medical grade lasers to gently stimulate blood flow in your scalp. This increased circulation brings more oxygen & nutrients directly to your hair follicles, recharging them and helping them grow stronger, thicker, and healthier hair!

What's Included

  • The Kiierr 272 Premier Laser Cap

  • A lightweight baseball-style cap for discreet wear

  • A rechargeable battery pack

  • Power cord and wall adapter

  • User guide with simple setup and care instructions

  • A 2-year manufacturer warranty

Instructions

  • Charge the battery fully.

  • Connect the battery pack to the cap.

  • Place the cap on clean, dry hair and press power.

  • Use for 30 minutes every other day.

  • The cap will automatically turn off after the treatment ends.

Specifications

Power Output: 1360 mw

Number of Laser Diodes: 272

Laser Wavelength: 650nm

Output Mode: Pulsing

Treatment Time: 30 Mins Every Other Day

 

Sizing: The Kiierr 272 Premier is designed to sit higher on the scalp rather than fit snugly to ensure optimal coverage across the most common areas for hair loss. Most head shapes and sizes fit the Kiierr 272 Premier (23.5" circumference)


If you are interested in our 272 Elite XL (fits 24.5) you can find that here.

Warranty: Kiierr laser caps come with a 2-year warranty, which covers any defects or failures. 


Shipping: New orders normally process within 2-3 business days & are shipped with 2-Day Shipping via USPS Priority or FedEx. Shipping within the US is free. We ship to almost all countries & international shipping is $55 USD (plus customs fees charged by FedEx)

Frequently Asked Questions

Message us at sales@kiierr.com to connect with a dedicated support agent. Our small, knowledgeable team personally responds to every email (no bots or AI). We’re always here to help and make sure your questions are answered quickly & with care.

Laser Cap Questions

Will this product work for me?

Kiierr laser caps are designed to help both men and women experiencing hair thinning or loss caused by common conditions such as androgenetic alopecia (male or female pattern baldness), postpartum hair loss, menopause-related thinning, stress-induced shedding, or general hair weakening with age. The caps use low-level laser therapy (LLLT), a safe, non-invasive technology that stimulates hair follicles, increases blood flow, and supports stronger, thicker hair growth over time. It works best for those who still have active follicles, meaning some existing hair is present. While results vary from person to person, most users who stay consistent with their treatment see visible improvement in hair fullness and scalp health.

When can I expect results?

Everyone’s hair growth cycle is different, but most users notice early improvements within the first few months. During the initial phase, you may experience some light shedding as weak hairs make way for stronger new growth. Visible thickening and regrowth typically begin around the 3-6 month mark, with the most noticeable results appearing between 6-12 months of consistent use. Continued use helps maintain and enhance your results over time.

What model should I choose?

Kiierr offers several laser cap models so you can choose the one that fits your needs and goals.


The 148 Pro model is a great entry-level choice for those just starting their hair growth journey. It is used every other day for 30 mins and fits up to 23.5" in circumference.


The 272 Premier and 272 Elite XL models provide stronger coverage and are ideal for users with moderate thinning or those wanting faster, fuller results. It is used every other day for 30 mins & fits up to 23.5" in circumference for the standard and 24.5" for the XL.


The 272 DualWave combines 2 laser wavelengths for deeper follicle stimulation and added effectiveness. It is used 6 minutes daily & has a softer, more flexible deisgn.


For those looking for maximum coverage and power, the 302 UltraFlex and 312 DualWave are our most advanced options, featuring the highest diode count and full scalp stimulation. These models are used 6 minutes daily & have a softer, more flexible deisgn.


No matter which you choose, all models use medical grade lasers and deliver the same proven therapy. Higher diode counts simply increase scalp coverage & treatment intensity.

What payment options do you have?

We accept all major payment methods through Shopify, including credit and debit cards, PayPal, and Shop Pay.


You can also use your FSA or HSA account for reimbursement.

Do you have a warranty?

Yes, every Kiierr laser cap comes with a full two-year warranty. If you experience any issues during that time, our support team is happy to help with repairs or replacements. Simply email us, and we’ll make sure you’re taken care of quickly and easily.

What if I don't see results?

Consistency is key with low-level laser therapy. Make sure to follow the recommended treatment schedule and continue using your cap regularly for at least 7 months. Because hair growth happens gradually, it can help to take photos every month to track your progress. If you’ve used your cap consistently and haven’t noticed results after the full treatment period, reach out to our support team. You can read our full policy here.
